title: Runtime lifecycle (tmux): up twice, spawn, status, read-only attach, logs, terminal status, kill/down, descendant stop, failed fetch, recover from disk, coordinator-only topology

steps.name: up-again-no-duplicate
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; n=$(tmux list-windows -t $T | wc -l); out=$($C up $P); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -q "already running" && test "$(tmux list-windows -t $T | wc -l)" -eq "$n"

steps.name: spawn-builder-2
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; $C spawn builder --issue 2 $P --timeout 10

steps.name: spawn-builder-2-again-refused
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; $C spawn builder --issue 2 $P --timeout 10

steps.name: spawn-builder-3
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; $C spawn builder --issue 3 $P --timeout 10

steps.name: unique-worktrees-and-run-block
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; wt() { python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['worktree'])" $S/runs/$1.json; }; a=$(wt builder-2) && b=$(wt builder-3) || exit 1; echo "$a $b"; test "$a" != "$b" && test -d "$a" && test -d "$b" || exit 1; for f in builder-2 builder-3; do test "$(grep -cE "^- (Item|Pass|Base|Worktree|Engine|Claim): " $S/runs/$f.brief.md)" -eq 6 || exit 1; done; grep -E "^- (Item|Pass|Base):" $S/runs/builder-2.brief.md

steps.name: status-alive
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; $C status $P | tee /dev/stderr | grep -E "^builder-2 .* alive" && $C status $P | grep -E "^builder-3 .* alive"

steps.name: attach-readonly-sends-no-input
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; tmux new-session -d -s view-{run_id} "env -u TMUX $C attach builder-2 $P" || exit 1; for i in $(seq 50); do tmux list-clients -t $T | grep -q . && break; sleep 0.1; done; tmux list-clients -t $T -F "#{client_readonly} #{session_name}" | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q "^1 "; ro=$?; tmux send-keys -t view-{run_id} "campaign-attach-probe" Enter; sleep 1; tmux kill-session -t view-{run_id}; test $ro -eq 0 && test -f {state_dir}/stub.log && ! grep -q "campaign-attach-probe" {state_dir}/stub.log

steps.name: logs-step-summary
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; w=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['worktree'])" $S/runs/builder-2.json); python3 {source}/scripts/step-summary.py --root "$w" --ref issue-2 --run-id build --step campaign --status ok --duration 1 --outcome campaign-logs-probe && $C logs builder-2 $P | grep campaign-logs-probe

steps.name: terminal-status-shown
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; echo "done: #3 #9 abc1234" >> $S/status/builder-3.status; $C status $P | grep -E "^builder-3 .*done: #3 #9 abc1234"

steps.name: kill-delegates-to-builder-lead
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; out=$($C kill builder-2 $P) || exit 1; echo "$out"; id=$(echo "$out" | sed -n "s/crew: sent \([^ ]*\) to builder-lead/\1/p"); test -n "$id" && $C acked builder-lead "$id" $P --wait 10 && grep -q '"action": "reclaim"' $S/leads/builder-events/*.json && tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -qx builder-2

steps.name: lead-kill-dirty-keeps-worktree
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; w=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['worktree'])" $S/runs/builder-2.json); echo wip > "$w/wip.txt"; CREW_POOL=builder $C kill builder-2 $P; rc=$?; test $rc -eq 1 && test -f "$w/wip.txt" && test -f $S/runs/builder-2.json && ! tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -qx builder-2

steps.name: kill-stops-descendant-group
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; tmux send-keys -t "=$T:builder-3" "campaign-exec: perl -e 'setpgrp(0,0); \$SIG{TERM}=q(IGNORE); \$0=q(campaign-survivor-{run_id}); sleep 600' &" Enter; for i in $(seq 50); do pgrep -f campaign-survivor-{run_id} >/dev/null && break; sleep 0.1; done; pgrep -f campaign-survivor-{run_id} || exit 3; CREW_POOL=builder $C kill builder-3 $P; for i in $(seq 50); do pgrep -f campaign-survivor-{run_id} >/dev/null || break; sleep 0.1; done; ! pgrep -f campaign-survivor-{run_id}

steps.name: server-crash-recover-from-disk
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; tmux kill-session -t =$T; sleep 0.5; $C up $P && test "$(tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -cE '^builder-[0-9]')" -eq 0 && $C status $P | tee /dev/stderr | grep -E "^builder-2 .* missing"

steps.name: failed-fetch-spawn-refused
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; mv {state_dir}/../origin.git {state_dir}/../origin.off; $C spawn builder --issue 4 $P --timeout 10; rc=$?; mv {state_dir}/../origin.off {state_dir}/../origin.git; test $rc -ne 0 && test ! -e $S/runs/builder-4.json && test ! -e $S/claims/builder-issue4 && ! tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -qx builder-4

steps.name: down-keeps-unlanded
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; $C down $P; rc=$?; w=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['worktree'])" $S/runs/builder-2.json); test -f "$w/wip.txt" && echo "down rc=$rc"

steps.name: coordinator-only-topology
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; tmux kill-session -t =$T 2>/dev/null; $C up $P --coordinator-only || exit 1; tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_index} #{window_name}" | tee /dev/stderr | grep -qx "0 ash" || exit 1; ! tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -q lead
